# Phase 5 fair comparison (generated by `utils/fair_comparison.py` from `metrics.json` files)

All local values: final-round test accuracy %, mean over seeds 1 to 5, Apple M5 laptop CPU (3 runs in parallel, 3 threads each); wall-clock is simulation cost. The paper row is paper-reported, not run locally. MerLin rows are an adaptation, not the paper's model. A difference is counted as above or below only if it exceeds the larger seed standard deviation.
